entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave Albania.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir de Albania.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave Albania.

entry.en: You will be denied entry without a valid travel document or with a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: Se te denegará la entrada sin un documento de viaje válido o con un pasaporte denunciado como perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Road and tourist taxes on entering or leaving Albania have been lifted as of 2021.
entry.es: Las tasas de carretera y turísticas al entrar o salir de Albania se eliminaron en 2021.
entry.quote: All road and tourist taxes (upon entering or leaving) the country have been lifted as of 2021.

safety.en: Crime and violence exist in some areas, but reports of crime targeting foreigners are rare.
safety.es: Hay delincuencia y violencia en algunas zonas, pero los delitos dirigidos a extranjeros son poco comunes.
safety.quote: There is crime and violence in some areas, but reports of crime targeting foreigners are rare.

safety.en: Watch out for pickpockets and bag thieves in tourist areas, on buses and trains and at major transport hubs including airports.
safety.es: Cuidado con carteristas y ladrones de bolsos en zonas turísticas, autobuses, trenes y grandes nodos de transporte, incluidos aeropuertos.
safety.quote: Watch out for pickpockets and bag thieves in tourist areas, on buses and trains and major public transport hubs, including airports.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Albania cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Albania.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Albania cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Political demonstrations have been held in central Tirana, with some reported incidents of violence.
safety.es: Se han celebrado manifestaciones políticas en el centro de Tirana, con algunos incidentes violentos.
safety.quote: Political and other demonstrations have been held in central Tirana, with some reported incidents of violence.

safety.en: Possession of illegal drugs could result in a prison sentence of 5 to 10 years.
safety.es: La posesión de drogas ilegales podría conllevar una pena de prisión de 5 a 10 años.
safety.quote: Possession of illegal drugs could result in a prison sentence of 5 to 10 years.

safety.en: Most people do not follow Albania's speed limits, so extra attention is needed when driving on highways.
safety.es: La mayoría no respeta los límites de velocidad en Albania, por lo que hay que prestar más atención al conducir en autopista.
safety.quote: Albania does have speed limits, but most people do not follow them.

health.en: Do not drink the tap water in Albania; drink only bottled water.
health.es: No bebas agua del grifo en Albania; bebe solo agua embotellada.
health.quote: Do not drink the tap water in Albania, as it may cause illness. Only drink bottled water.

health.en: Medical and dental facilities are very poor, particularly outside Tirana.
health.es: Los servicios médicos y dentales son muy deficientes, sobre todo fuera de Tirana.
health.quote: Medical and dental facilities, including accident and emergency facilities, are very poor, particularly outside Tirana.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Albania.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Albania.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Albania.

health.en: Pharmacies and other stores are closed from about 12:00 to 16:00.
health.es: Las farmacias y otras tiendas cierran aproximadamente de 12:00 a 16:00.
health.quote: Pharmacies and other stores are closed from about 12:00-16:00.

health.en: Rabies vaccines are hard to get in Albania, and bite victims may need to reach Montenegro, Kosovo or Greece within 24 hours.
health.es: Las vacunas antirrábicas son difíciles de conseguir en Albania y quien sea mordido quizá deba llegar a Montenegro, Kosovo o Grecia en 24 horas.
health.quote: If you get bitten, your only alternatives are to get to Montenegro, Kosovo or Greece as quickly as possible (within 24 hr) to get vaccinated there.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Albania are ambulance 127, fire 128 and police 112.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Albania son ambulancia 127, bomberos 128 y policía 112.

help.en: The Albanian authorities do not always inform the British Embassy when British nationals are arrested.
help.es: Las autoridades albanesas no siempre informan a la embajada británica cuando arrestan a ciudadanos británicos.
help.quote: The Albanian authorities do not always inform the British Embassy when British nationals have been arrested.

getting_in.en: Tirana's Mother Teresa International Airport is a 15-minute drive from the city.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Madre Teresa de Tirana está a 15 minutos en coche de la ciudad.
getting_in.quote: Tirana's Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA IATA) is 15 minutes drive from the city.

getting_in.en: The Albanian Riviera can be reached by flying to Corfu and taking the hydrofoil to Saranda.
getting_in.es: A la Riviera albanesa se puede llegar volando a Corfú y tomando el hidroala a Saranda.
getting_in.quote: Another cheaper and convenient way to reach the Albanian Riviera in Southern Albania is by flying to Corfu (CFU IATA) and taking the hydrofoil to Saranda.

getting_in.en: Pristina Airport in Kosovo is 3-4 hours or 15 euros from Tirana.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Pristina en Kosovo está a 3-4 horas o 15 euros de Tirana.
getting_in.quote: Pristina International Airport (PRN IATA) in Kosovo with many connections is just 3-4 hr or €15 from Tirana.

getting_around.en: Buses and furgons (minibuses) are the most reliable ways to travel around Albania.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses y furgones (minibuses) son la forma más fiable de viajar por Albania.
getting_around.quote: Buses and furgons (minibuses) are the most reliable ways to travel around Albania.

getting_around.en: Since August 2024 Google Maps has most intercity bus connections and times.
getting_around.es: Desde agosto de 2024 Google Maps incluye la mayoría de conexiones y horarios de autobuses interurbanos.
getting_around.quote: Since August 2024, Google Maps has most intercity bus connections and times available and can be used for quite reliable trip planning.

getting_around.en: All passenger trains seem to have been suspended since COVID and due to budget issues.
getting_around.es: Todos los trenes de pasajeros parecen suspendidos desde el COVID y por problemas presupuestarios.
getting_around.quote: All passenger trains seem to have been suspended since COVID and due to budget issues.

getting_around.en: There are no highway fees except on the Rruga e Kombit (A1), with toll points near Tirana airport and Morinë.
getting_around.es: No hay peajes en las autopistas salvo en la Rruga e Kombit (A1), con puntos cerca del aeropuerto de Tirana y Morinë.
getting_around.quote: There are no fees for using the highways - with the exception of the Rruga e Kombit highway (A1) which has a toll point near Tirana International Airport, and one near Morinë, the border with Kosovo.

getting_around.en: Minor roads can be poor, deeply pitted or non-existent.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras secundarias pueden estar en mal estado, llenas de baches o incluso no existir.
getting_around.quote: Road surfaces can be poor, deeply pitted, or non-existent

money.en: The national currency is the lek (ALL).
money.es: La moneda nacional es el lek (ALL).
money.quote: The national currency is the lek (plural lekë, symbol L, ISO code: ALL).

money.en: Cards are widely accepted, but many smaller shops and stalls take cash only, so it is wise to carry cash.
money.es: Las tarjetas se aceptan ampliamente, pero muchas tiendas pequeñas solo aceptan efectivo, así que conviene llevar efectivo.
money.quote: It is therefore wise to always have cash on hand.

money.en: All ATMs in Albania charge a withdrawal fee.
money.es: Todos los cajeros de Albania cobran una comisión por retiro.
money.quote: All ATMs in Albania charge a withdrawal fee.

money.en: Decline dynamic currency conversion, which is often off the market rate by 7% or more.
money.es: Rechaza la conversión dinámica de divisa, que a menudo se desvía un 7% o más del tipo de mercado.
money.quote: It is often off the market rate by 7% or more, whereas your bank's rate is typically only off 1–3%.

money.en: Many Albanians still speak in 'old lek', so '200 lek' may be said as dy mijë lek, meaning 2000.
money.es: Muchos albaneses aún hablan en 'lek antiguo', así que '200 lek' puede decirse dy mijë lek, es decir 2000.
money.quote: For instance, for "200 lek" they would say dy mijë lek, literally meaning 2000 lek

etiquette.en: Elder males expect respect because of their age, and men of the family should be shaken hands with.
etiquette.es: Los varones mayores esperan respeto por su edad; a los hombres de la familia hay que darles la mano.
etiquette.quote: elder males expect to be shown respect on account of their age. Men of the family have to be respected in particular. Shake hands with them and do not argue about topics such as religion and politics.

etiquette.en: Homosexuality is a strictly taboo topic in some company; the text says not to speak about gay rights.
etiquette.es: La homosexualidad es un tema estrictamente tabú en algunos ámbitos; el texto indica no hablar de derechos LGBT.
etiquette.quote: Certain topics are strictly taboo, homosexuality being one. Don't speak about gay rights, no matter what.

etiquette.en: Men commonly kiss cheeks of men their age or younger, even on first meeting.
etiquette.es: Es común que los hombres se besen las mejillas con hombres de su edad o menores, incluso al conocerse.
etiquette.quote: In Albania it's common for men to kiss cheeks of males of their age or younger, even the first time they meet them.

etiquette.en: There is a lot of mistrust and resentment towards Serbia in Albania, so avoid being overly enthusiastic about it.
etiquette.es: Hay mucha desconfianza y resentimiento hacia Serbia en Albania, así que evita mostrar demasiado entusiasmo por ella.
etiquette.quote: there is a great deal of mistrust and resentment towards Serbia in Albania. Try to avoid being overly enthusiastic about Serbia

connectivity.en: Vodafone has the best coverage as of September 2021, with 4G in Tirana, other main towns and highways between.
connectivity.es: Vodafone tiene la mejor cobertura (septiembre de 2021), con 4G en Tirana, otras ciudades principales y las autopistas entre ellas.
connectivity.quote: As of Sept 2021, Vodafone has the best coverage, with 4G in Tirana, the other main towns, and highways between.

connectivity.en: A passport is required to buy a prepaid SIM.
connectivity.es: Se necesita pasaporte para comprar una SIM prepago.
connectivity.quote: You must provide a passport to purchase a prepaid SIM.

connectivity.en: Many bars and restaurants have Wi-Fi readily available, just ask.
connectivity.es: Muchos bares y restaurantes tienen Wi-Fi disponible, solo hay que pedirlo.
connectivity.quote: Many bars and restaurant have Wi-Fi readily available, just ask.

connectivity.en: A One.al SIM from Albania works in North Macedonia and Kosovo with a regular Albanian package.
connectivity.es: Una SIM de One.al de Albania funciona en Macedonia del Norte y Kosovo con un paquete albanés normal.
connectivity.quote: a One.al SIM card from Albania works flawlessly in North Macedonia and Kosovo with a regular Albanian package.
